design: Purposeful four-page descriptive snapshot from the existing catalogue: click service, link marketplace, hosting and task-solving service. Selected to compare billing units, not randomly or to estimate a market. No private venue, transaction, account or purchase data.
retrieval: Public web research reader; each URL and any direct HTTP inconsistency retained. Page content may change.
coding: Record delivery unit, displayed offer and unknown conditions; do not coerce missing prices to zero. No cross-product price average.

records.name: SerpClix
records.observed: Starter displayed $197 per month and 6,000 credits. The page distinguishes all-country and single-country credit consumption.
records.currency: Dollar symbol displayed; ISO currency and checkout taxes not confirmed
records.limits: Posted offer, no purchase or delivery test; direct automated request returned 503 while the public research reader returned pricing content.

records.name: Sape
records.observed: Public page displayed a from-one-cent teaser and directed signup to Serpzilla.
records.currency: Not established from the inspected teaser
records.billing: Duration and full placement terms not established
records.limits: The teaser cannot support an average placement price, a completed sale or verified link quality.

records.name: Easy Blog Networks
records.unit: Hosting plan selected by number of blogs
records.observed: Page offered a blog-count selector and stated prices exclude tax. Numeric plan amounts were not exposed in the inspected text representation.
records.limits: Missing rendered price is unresolved, not zero cost. No account was created.

records.name: 2Captcha
records.observed: Inspected response displayed normal-captcha rates of £0.45–£0.89 per 1,000. Other task types and services had different units.
records.currency: GBP symbol in this response; locale-dependent display
records.limits: Recorded displayed range only; no currency conversion, service testing, tax confirmation or checkout performed.

limitations: Small purposeful convenience set; public-facing offers only; vendor self-presentation; regional/JS display effects; asking prices not sales. No prevalence, market-size, typical price, effectiveness or profitability estimate.
